channel.title: Chovy's Blog
channel.description: Tech, agentic coding, and whatever else I'm building. By Anthony "chovy" Ettinger.

item.title: readm3 can edit now, and it speaks Reddit
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: readm3 0.3.0 adds an edit mode and swaps its hand-rolled parser for marked, with CommonMark, GitHub and Reddit flavors behind a --flavor switch.

item.title: Two movies, forty thousand files
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: DiskPush 0.2.17: a pane selection that reached the UI and nothing else, a direction button that did the opposite, and the rsync flag that copies empty folders and exits zero.

item.title: What running 36 agents in a day actually looks like
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: 36 agent sessions, 24 working directories, $2390 of API-equivalent spend in 24 hours. What moshcode's herd and cost commands show you, and the two ways the cost table lies if you read it wrong.

item.title: Why we still reach for Jobs and Musk
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: The Jobs and Musk personas survived the arguments about the men because they became units of measurement. The one worth copying is the boring half, it scales down to one developer, and Profullstack is hiring a homeless usability tester.

item.title: A spinner is not a status
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: DiskPush 0.2.16: a mirror preview that sat on a spinner for minutes, 71MB of IPC nobody read, and two layout bugs only a screenshot could find.

item.title: The other side of the marketplace
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: nichedb.dev now pays people who know an industry, 20 to 80 percent, and what stops the score being farmed

item.title: The bots now pay the humans
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: CrawlProof's new earn rail: AI crawlers buy day passes, a share funds a pool, and people and agents get paid out of it for real engagement. Solvent by construction, and either side can pay either.

item.title: The pay2seed hub is live on bittorrented.com
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: The pay2seed hub is running on bittorrented.com: signed consent at upload, escrowed offers, leases paid per proven period, four payment lanes and a 1 percent take.

item.title: Your money in the terminal: coinpay finances
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: coinpay finances puts earnings, commission, refunds, bank and card feeds, the ledger, invoices, escrow and debt against income on one terminal screen.

item.title: Why it is called readm3
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: readm3 is README with the last letter swapped for a digit, lifted from the 3MTA3 gag on the Beastie Boys' Licensed to Ill cover.
